1–2 days of play (10 shrines scattered across the map), not counting the access quests

In {wiki:Blue Valley}, {npc:Enpa-Deia Pema} invites you to follow the path of the ancient Merudri: a pilgrimage to **10 shrines** scattered across the map, from Targuna to the Kilmaresh Mountains, which must be used **in order**, each with a minimum level (from 6 to 275). Each shrine gives experience (847.8k XP in total) and, for {wiki:Monk|Monks}, Enlightenment equipment, spells and permanent autoattack bonuses. At the end, Pema gives you **10 Promotion Points** for the {wiki:Wheel of Destiny} and you receive the achievement **Hope of the Merudri**.
Follow the path of the ancient Merudri to gain the wisdom and abilities worthy of a true monk.
There is no minimum level to start, but each shrine requires a minimum level (6, 20, 30, 40, 50, 70, 100, 110, 150 and 275). You need **level 275** to finish the quest.
{item:Rope}, {item:Shovel} and {item:Machete} (or the {item:Secret Agent Tools}, which do the same job).

Shrine 3 (Tyrsung): the {wiki:Barbarian Test Quest} done and the *Nibelor 2: Ecological Terrorism* mission of {wiki:The Ice Islands Quest} at least started, so that {npc:Buddel} takes you to {wiki:Tyrsung}.

Shrine 7 (Pits of Inferno): having reached the *The Levers* mission of {wiki:The Pits of Inferno Quest}. To cross the purple flames of the Hall of the Five Ways you need one player of each vocation (or players with lots of health).
Shrine 8 (Corruption Hole): having handed in **8** {item:Tome of Knowledge|Tomes of Knowledge} to {npc:Cael} ({wiki:Tomes of Knowledge Quest}).
Shrine 9 (Barkless Cult Trial Zone): having reached the *The Powerful Relic* stage of the Barkless mission of the {wiki:Cults of Tibia Quest}.
to go to the Adventurers' Guild and from there to Blue Valley; ask any temple NPC for it
to climb up through the holes in several caves
for the Loose Stone Pile in the Plains of Havoc graveyard (Pits of Inferno)
required by the wiki for the pilgrimage
to open the hole in the graveyard and cool the lava in the Pits of Inferno
to get past the Shrine of Wonders on the way to the Pits of Inferno
to use on Goshnar's grave (Pits of Inferno); bring several flasks
for the lever of the Pits of Inferno bridge, if it is broken
recommended in the Pits of Inferno
optional: makes Buddel take you to the right place and is recommended in the Hall of the Five Ways
optional: replaces the 5,000 gp for the boat to/from Targuna
Money for boats and magic carpets (5,000 gp for Targuna, 50 gp for Buddel, 60–100 gp per carpet)
**847,800 experience** in total (from 300 to 500,000 XP per shrine; see the table in section 1)
**10 Promotion Points** to spend on the {wiki:Wheel of Destiny}
The **Hope of the Merudri** achievement and the *Pensive Wanderer* character title
Monks only: +25% base auto-attack damage (50% when you are {wiki:Serene|Serene}) and +2% damage reduction against melee auto-attacks for each shrine
Monks only: the {spell:Mystic Repulse}, {spell:Forceful Uppercut} and {spell:Focus Harmony} spells
10 Promotion Points in the Wheel of Destiny
When you say {key:pilgrimage} to {npc:Enpa-Deia Pema} after using the 10 shrines.
Monk spells Mystic Repulse, Forceful Uppercut and Focus Harmony
By using the Shrine of Respect (Tyrsung), the Shrine of Knowledge (Corruption Hole) and the Shrine of Eternity (Kilmaresh Mountains).
Permanent autoattack bonuses from the shrines
Shrine by shrine: +5% base autoattack at Respect, Legacy, Empathy, Harmony and Power, and +2% damage reduction against melee autoattacks at each of the 10.
Monks only; the autoattack bonus doubles when you are Serene.
The shrines must be used **in the order of the table**, from the lowest level to the highest. If you skip one, you cannot progress in the following ones.
If you do not yet have the level for the next shrine, the pilgrimage stops there until you level up. The first six shrines (up to level 70) can be done early.

Do the access quests first: Barbarian Test and Ice Islands up to *Nibelor 2*, Pits of Inferno up to *The Levers*, The New Frontier completed, 8 Tomes of Knowledge and Barkless up to *The Powerful Relic*. Without them you get stuck halfway.
Only the Pits of Inferno shrine needs a team (to open the flames in the Hall of the Five Ways); all the others can be done solo.
{npc:Enpa-Deia Pema} also heals (up to 65 HP), removes negative conditions and buys and sells the Enlightenment items.

Monks: the shrines' auto-attack bonus doubles when you are {wiki:Serene|Serene}. You lose that state with party members nearby or with 6 or more monsters next to you; outside a party you are almost always Serene.
A {item:Temple Teleport Scroll} saves you the trip back from deep places such as the Maze of Lost Souls, the Pits of Inferno or the Corruption Hole.
1. Getting started: Enpa-Deia Pema in Blue Valley
Wiki note: if you play any vocation other than Monk, start the quest here.

Go to the temple of any city and use an {item:Adventurer's Stone}: you are taken to the {wiki:Adventurers' Guild}. If you do not have the stone, ask the temple NPC for it: {key:hi}, {key:adventurer's stone}, {key:yes}.
Upper floor of the Adventurers' Guild

On the guild's **upper floor**, next to the Reward Shrine, use the {wiki:Enchanted Guarded Crystal Sphere}. You are teleported to {wiki:Blue Valley}, the island of the Merudri monks, north of Krailos.
Ask Enpa-Deia Pema for the pilgrimage

{npc:Enpa-Deia Pema} is in the temple, right next to where you arrive. Say {key:hi} and {key:pilgrimage}. She explains that everyone is welcome to visit the ancient Merudri shrines, but that the journey is arduous and demands endurance.

The shrines are scattered across the map and must be used **in this order**. Each one has a minimum level and gives a reward; Monks get their own rewards. To use a shrine, reach the spot and **use it** (Use).
{item:Boots of Enlightenment} + 2% reduction against melee auto-attacks
{spell:Mystic Repulse} + 5% base auto-attack (10% in Serene) + 2% reduction
{item:Legs of Enlightenment} + 5% auto-attack (10% in Serene) + 2% reduction
{item:Nunchaku of Enlightenment} + 5% auto-attack (10% in Serene) + 2% reduction
{item:Coned Hat of Enlightenment} + 5% auto-attack (10% in Serene) + 2% reduction
{item:Sai of Enlightenment} + 5% auto-attack (10% in Serene) + 2% reduction
500,000 XP + **Hope of the Merudri** achievement + *Pensive Wanderer* title
If you skip a shrine, you cannot progress in the following ones. Always use them in the order of the table.

Use one of the {wiki:Guarded Crystal Sphere|Guarded Crystal Spheres} near the temple to start the pilgrimage: they take you back to the Adventurers' Guild. There, use the guild's exit portal, which returns you to the temple you came from.

Go to the harbour in **Thais** and talk to {npc:Captain Bluebear}: {key:hi}, {key:targuna}, {key:yes}. In the wiki's table this route is listed at 0 gp “after paying 5,000 gp or handing in a Sail Pass”, so bring the 5,000 gp or a {item:Sail Pass}. You arrive at {npc:Captain Indigo}'s boat, in {wiki:Targuna}, the island where new players arrive after Newhaven.
Go to the **north** of the island, to the stairs leading down to the {wiki:Hidden Lizard Temple} ({coord:31936,31863,7}). The Shrine of Guidance is right next to them: use it.
300 XP; Monks: {item:Boots of Enlightenment} + 2% damage reduction against melee auto-attacks

Go back to the boat and talk to {npc:Captain Indigo}: {key:hi}, {key:thais}, {key:yes}. She only sails to Thais. The wiki's table shows the same condition (0 gp after paying 5,000 gp or handing in a {item:Sail Pass}); Sail Passes drop from {creature:Infernoid Blob|Infernoid Blobs}, {creature:Lizard Henchman|Lizard Henchmen} and {creature:Pirate Navigator|Pirate Navigators}, creatures from the Targuna area.

Leave **Thais** by the south exit and walk **south** to the area of the {wiki:White Flower Temple} ({coord:32346,32364,7}) and the entrance of the {wiki:Thais Bat Dungeon} ({coord:32331,32383,7}). The Shrine of Tranquility is nearby, south-west of the temple, **1 floor above ground** (z=6).
The wiki only gives the shrine's position. Keep {spell:Levitate} (or parcels) at hand, as the quest requires, in case you need to go up.
Go up to the shrine (1 floor above ground) and use it.
2,500 XP; Monks: {item:Fists of Enlightenment} + 2% damage reduction against melee auto-attacks
Go down the same way you came up and walk back **north** to Thais.
The shrine is at the top of the mountain on {wiki:Tyrsung}, the island east of Svargrond, on the same floor as the Court of Winter portal.
Take a boat to **Svargrond** (for example with {npc:Captain Bluebear}, in Thais: {key:hi}, {key:svargrond}, {key:yes}). Then go to the small boat **south** of the city, where {npc:Buddel} is.

Talk to {npc:Buddel}: {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:tyrsung} (50 gp). He only takes you if you have done the {wiki:Barbarian Test Quest} and started the *Nibelor 2* mission of {wiki:The Ice Islands Quest}. You disembark at the Tyrsung pier.

Buddel is always drunk and may take you to the wrong place. With a {item:Dwarven Ring} in your backpack he takes you to the right destination and does not charge the 50 gp, but he keeps the ring. If you do not want to lose it, say {key:no} when he asks for it (or put the ring in the ring slot, if you only have one).
Climb to the top of the mountain

Go to the mountain in the centre of the island ({wiki:Jotunar}) and climb it via the points marked below, floor by floor, to the top (z=3, 4 floors above ground). On the mountain there are {creature:Frost Giant|Frost Giants}, {creature:Frost Giantess|Frost Giantesses} and {creature:Mammoth|Mammoths}.

The Shrine of Respect is on the same floor as the Court of Winter portal (z=3), further **east/south-east** ({coord:32411,31274,3}). The wiki only gives the shrine's position, not the route from the top: follow the coordinate and keep {spell:Levitate} and a {item:Rope} at hand to change floors if needed. When you get there, use it.
5,000 XP; Monks: {spell:Mystic Repulse} spell + 5% base auto-attack (10% in Serene) + 2% damage reduction against melee auto-attacks

Go down the mountain via the same points, go to the pier and talk to {npc:Buddel}: {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:svargrond}. You return to the pier south of Svargrond, where you can take a boat to other cities.
Take a boat to **Ab'Dendriel** (for example with {npc:Captain Bluebear}, in Thais: {key:hi}, {key:ab'dendriel}, {key:yes}; 130 gp). You arrive at the harbour, next to {npc:Captain Seagull}.
{wiki:Elvenbane} is an island **west** of Ab'Dendriel and can only be reached through an underground cave. Leave the city heading west to the cave entrance and follow the cave to the island.

The castle's passages are so narrow that only one person can get through at a time. Watch out for {creature:Orc Berserker|Orc Berserkers} and {creature:Minotaur Guard|Minotaur Guards} lured by other players.
The Shrine of Legacy is on the island, at ground level (z=7). Go there and use it.
10,000 XP; Monks: {item:Legs of Enlightenment} + 5% base auto-attack (10% in Serene) + 2% damage reduction against melee auto-attacks
Go back through the same underground cave to the entrance ({coord:32579,31680,7}) and walk **east** to Ab'Dendriel.
6. Shrine 5 — Empathy (Maze of Lost Souls, level 50)
The shrine is deep in the {wiki:Maze of Lost Souls}, beneath the Fields of Glory, north of Carlin (z=13). The maze has one-way tunnels and it is very easy to get lost.

Take a boat to **Carlin** (for example with {npc:Captain Bluebear}, in Thais: {key:hi}, {key:carlin}, {key:yes}; 110 gp); you arrive next to {npc:Captain Greyhound}. Leave the city to the **north** through the {wiki:Fields of Glory} to the spot where you go down to the maze entrance, and go down there.
Way down to the Maze of Lost Souls entrance

Down there, go to the nearest hole and go down. Walk to the small patch of grass to the **east** and enter the hidden hole in the **north-west corner**. Turn the lever to the **right** and go back up. If the lever is already turned to the right, turn it to the left and then to the right again (the hole may have returned to its initial state after a Floor Reset).
Go to this hole and enter it: you are in the Maze of Lost Souls. You need level 30 to enter.
Maze of Lost Souls entrance hole

The shrine is at {coord:32532,31571,13}, 4 floors below the entrance hole. The wiki shows the correct route in an image that is not available here, so follow the coordinate and the maze maps. Mark dead ends and tunnels you have already explored on the minimap (at maximum zoom); you can also leave stones or rubbish as markers at corridor entrances.
15,000 XP; Monks: {item:Nunchaku of Enlightenment} + 5% base auto-attack (10% in Serene) + 2% damage reduction against melee auto-attacks
Leave the Maze of Lost Souls

Since there are one-way tunnels, you cannot always go back the way you came. Retrace your route to the entrance hole ({coord:32483,31633,9}) using your markers and the {item:Rope}, and climb up to the Fields of Glory; from there head back **south** to Carlin. If you get lost, use a {item:Temple Teleport Scroll}, as the wiki itself advises for this maze.
The shrine is on the route of the {wiki:Waterfall Quest}, in the jungle of {wiki:Tiquanda}, 2 floors above ground.
Take a boat to **Port Hope** (for example with {npc:Captain Bluebear}, in Thais: {key:hi}, {key:port hope}, {key:yes}). You arrive at the harbour, next to {npc:Charles}.
Cross the jungle to the hidden hole

Bring the {item:Machete} and head **east** through the jungle, passing the area south of {wiki:Banuta}. Cross the river on the log and go to the hidden hole near {npc:The Blind Prophet}, in northern Tiquanda, close to the Forbidden Lands. You can also come from the **south**, from {wiki:Kha'zeel|Kha'Zeel}, through the elephant area next to the {creature:Hydra|Hydras} spawn.
If you come from the south, watch out for {creature:Hydra|Hydras} lured by other players.
Climb up through the cave holes

Go down the hidden hole. Follow the cave **west** and climb up through the various holes with the {item:Rope} (this is the Waterfall Quest route). The shrine is 2 floors above ground (z=5), at the coordinate in the next step.
The Shrine of Harmony is at this point, 2 floors above ground (z=5). Use it.
30,000 XP; Monks: {item:Coned Hat of Enlightenment} + 5% base auto-attack (10% in Serene) + 2% damage reduction against melee auto-attacks

Go back the same way: go down through the holes, return through the cave to the hidden hole and come out into the jungle. Cross the river on the log and go back to **Port Hope** (or towards Kha'Zeel, if you came that way). If you carry on with the Waterfall Quest to the end (you jump off the waterfall and swim 1 square north), you leave the cave behind the waterfall through a teleport to the north; the wiki does not say where that teleport drops you.

The shrine is at the bottom of the {wiki:Pits of Inferno}, beneath the Plains of Havoc, in the lever area (PoI levers), beyond the Hall of the Five Ways. You have to retrace the route of {wiki:The Pits of Inferno Quest} to get there.
Prepare the gear and the team

Bring a {item:Shovel}, a {item:Rope}, a {item:Pick}, the {item:The Holy Tible|Holy Tible}, several flasks of {item:Blood} and {item:Oil} and {item:Destroy Field Rune|Destroy Field Runes}. For the flames in the Hall of the Five Ways you need **a Knight, a Paladin, a Sorcerer, a Druid and a Monk** (or players with lots of health and physical protection).
Where Key 3700 (south of Venore) and the Holy Tible (next to Knightwatch Tower) are

If you do not have the Holy Tible yet: it is in a chest inside the small mountain next to {wiki:Knightwatch Tower} ({coord:32828,32340,7}); you need {spell:Levitate} or 3 {item:Parcel|Parcels} to get up.

Go to the {wiki:Plains of Havoc}, **south-west** of Venore, to the graveyard next to the {wiki:Necromant House}. Use the {item:Shovel} on a {item:Loose Stone Pile} (there are several, all leading to the same narrow cave). In the **east** part of the cave there is a 3x4 room: use the {item:Pick} in the **north-west corner** and go down the hole.
Northwest corner: use the Pick here
Goshnar's grave, Shrine of Wonders, bridge and lava
Goshnar's grave is directly **west** of where you land. Stand **1 sqm south** of the gravestone and use the {item:Blood} on the gravestone: you are taken to the catacombs.
Get through the Shrine of Wonders

Go **north** (to the south there are {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons} and {creature:Ghost|Ghosts}, which do not matter). Before the Magic Wall, step on the tile with inscriptions with the {item:The Holy Tible|Holy Tible} in your backpack: you are taken to the other side.
Go down and cross the bridge

To the **east** there is a sign *To the Pits of Inferno*: go down that hole (level 30 door) and head **south** to the bridge. If it is broken, use the {item:Oil} on the lever **south of the bridge, on the west side**, pull it and cross.
If the bridge collapses with you on the other side, the only way back is through the dragon lair.
Cool the lava and get past the dragon lair

If there is lava in the way, use the {item:Pick} on the stone beside it to cool it. You reach 3 holes leading to the {wiki:Pits of Inferno Dragon Lair}: go down the **north** hole. Be ready for lots of {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords}. To the **east** there is a rope hole: climb up with the {item:Rope} and you reach the Hall of the Five Ways.

There are five paths with purple flames. Each player crosses the path of **their** vocation, climbs up through the rope hole at the end and **pulls the lever** in the room (no need to kill the 3 creatures). On the right path each flame takes 300 HP; on the wrong one the physical damage doubles with each flame.
Hall of the Five Ways: each vocation's path

On the wrong path (original vocations) the 10th tile deals 6,700 damage; a {item:Stone Skin Amulet} reduces the physical damage, but take it off on the last tile (11), which without it only deals 300. The Monk path has 13 tiles and the last one deals 300 fire + 51,200 physical; there you can use the Stone Skin Amulet (it drops to 10,240), so another vocation with lots of physical protection and 5,000 to 10,000 health/mana can open it.
A {item:Dwarven Ring} is highly recommended for everyone.

With the five levers pulled, the fire walls disappear and you move on to the lever area (PoI levers), which starts at {coord:32863,32345,12} and continues on the 3 floors below. The Shrine of Power is on the deepest floor (z=15): go there and use it. In this area there are {creature:Spectre|Spectres}, {creature:Diabolic Imp|Diabolic Imps}, {creature:Defiler|Defilers}, {creature:Destroyer|Destroyers}, {creature:Hellfire Fighter|Hellfire Fighters}, {creature:Plaguesmith|Plaguesmiths} and {creature:Lost Soul|Lost Souls}.
60,000 XP; Monks: {item:Sai of Enlightenment} + 5% base auto-attack (10% in Serene) + 2% damage reduction against melee auto-attacks

Go back the same way: Hall of the Five Ways, dragon lair, lava, bridge, Shrine of Wonders and catacombs, to the Plains of Havoc graveyard; from there head **north-east** to Venore. If the fire walls have already closed, use the emergency exit on the **east** side of the flames: it takes you to the west side and you leave through the dragon lair. You can also use a {item:Temple Teleport Scroll}.
The shrine is in the {wiki:Corruption Hole}, a cave hidden beneath the {wiki:Muggy Plains}, in the far north-east of Zao. You can only get in if you have already handed in 8 tomes to {npc:Cael}.

With {wiki:The New Frontier Quest} completed, the fastest way is the {wiki:Magic Carpet|magic carpet}: at the carpet in Darashia, Edron, Svargrond, Kazordoon, Femor Hills or Issavi say {key:hi}, {key:farmine}, {key:yes} (it also accepts {key:zao}). It costs 60 gp. You arrive at {npc:Melian}'s carpet, at the top of the Farmine mountain.
You can also go by steamship: {npc:Brodrosch}, far below Kazordoon, takes you to Farmine ({key:hi}, {key:farmine}, {key:yes}; 210 gp, 160 gp with The New Frontier discount).

Right next to {npc:Melian} there is an old lizard relic: the serpent head teleport, which you can use because you have already handed in at least 7 tomes to Cael. It takes you to the teleport in the north of the {wiki:Zao Steppe}, south of the Dragonblaze Peaks (the one that goes to the Muggy Plains). It is **one-way only**.
Lizard teleport to the Muggy Plains

If you came by steamship: in Farmine go **east** of {npc:Ongulf}, pass the sealed doors, stand on the switch and use the **right-hand lever**; the lift takes you to the surface. Follow the passage **east**, going down the mountain with {spell:Levitate} (or parcels), to the Zao Steppe ({coord:33085,31532,7}), and then go **north-east** to this teleport.
Enter the old lizard teleport: you arrive in the {wiki:Muggy Plains}. It only works for those who have done the first 8 missions of The New Frontier Quest.

Head **north-east**, past the rice fields, to the area with {creature:Mutated Tiger|Mutated Tigers}, {creature:Mutated Bat|Mutated Bats} and {creature:Death Blob|Death Blobs}. Go up the stairs and follow the mountain gorge; go up again, go **right** and pass the building (the temple of missions 4 and 5 of the {wiki:Children of the Revolution Quest}).
Go down into the Corruption Hole

On the **east** side of the temple there are wooden ramps: go down them and follow the path to a **hidden hole**. Go down it. If you have not yet handed in 8 {item:Tome of Knowledge|Tomes of Knowledge} to {npc:Cael}, you cannot get in.
Blue: you start here; pink: go down

You are on the first floor of the Corruption Hole (1 floor below ground), with {creature:Lizard Legionnaire|Lizard Legionnaires}, {creature:Lizard High Guard|Lizard High Guards}, {creature:Lizard Dragon Priest|Lizard Dragon Priests} and {creature:Lizard Chosen}. The Shrine of Knowledge is on this floor: go there and use it.
Corruption Hole: blue = you start here; pink = Ghastly Dragons
To the **south** there is a ramp going down to hordes of {creature:Lizard Chosen} and, north-west of that cave, 4 {creature:Ghastly Dragon|Ghastly Dragons}. You do not need to go down for the shrine.
75,000 XP; Monks: {spell:Forceful Uppercut} spell + 2% damage reduction against melee auto-attacks
Leave the Corruption Hole and Zao

Go back to where you dropped in and climb up again (the wiki does not describe the exit; bring a {item:Rope}); go up the ramps on the east side of the temple and retrace your route to the Muggy Plains teleport, which returns you to the Zao Steppe. To get back to Farmine, go to the passage through the mountains ({coord:33085,31532,7}), go up with {spell:Levitate} (or parcels) and head **west** to the lift. In Farmine, {npc:Thorgrin} takes you by steamship to Kazordoon ({key:hi}, {key:kazordoon}, {key:yes}; 210 gp, 160 gp with The New Frontier discount) and {npc:Melian}'s carpet, at the top of the Farmine mountain, flies to other cities.
10. Shrine 9 — Serenity (Barkless Cult Trial Zone, level 150)

The shrine is in the {wiki:Barkless Cult Trial Zone}, the Barkless cult area beneath northern Ab'Dendriel. You need to have reached the *The Powerful Relic* stage of the Barkless mission of the {wiki:Cults of Tibia Quest}, which means you have already passed the tar and sulphur trials and the purification.

In **Ab'Dendriel**, enter the troll cave. Go down again and then climb up the rope spot to the **south** with the {item:Rope}. Walk **north-east** to the {item:Mystic Flame} and then **west**, to {npc:Tigo}.
Enter the building **west** of {npc:Tigo} and leave through the **north** door. Follow the path and climb up the hole at the end: you are in the Barkless area.

The {creature:Barkless Devotee|Barkless Devotees} and {creature:Barkless Fanatic|Barkless Fanatics} are much stronger than normal elves and their Poison Ball deals quite a lot of damage, even with a blocker.
Go down to the floor below
Since the purification (*The Powerful Relic* stage) you can open the sealed door **west** of the trial area, which gives access to the floor below (z=9). Go through it and go down.
Floor below, after the sealed door
On this floor, head **east** to the Shrine of Serenity and use it.
150,000 XP; Monks: {item:Robe of Enlightenment} + 2% damage reduction against melee auto-attacks

Go back the same way to the troll cave entrance: go through the sealed door again, go down the hole you climbed up to the trial area, cross Tigo's building, go down the rope spot and climb the stairs up to the surface of Ab'Dendriel.

Take a boat to **Issavi** from Venore, Darashia, Krailos or Oramond ({key:hi}, {key:issavi}, {key:yes}); you arrive at {npc:Captain Harava}'s boat, at the harbour north of the city. You can also come by magic carpet ({key:hi}, {key:issavi}, {key:yes}; 100 gp from any carpet), arriving at {npc:Tanyt}'s platform.

The {wiki:Kilmaresh Mountains} are in the **centre** of the island of Kilmaresh, south of Issavi, between the Central Steppe and the Southern Steppe. Leave the city to the **south** and cross the steppes to the mountain. {creature:Gryphon|Gryphons} live here, as well as the creatures from the rest of the island.
The wiki does not describe the way up to the shrine: bring a {item:Rope} and {spell:Levitate}.
The Shrine of Eternity is at the top of the mountain, **3 floors above the ground** (z=4). Go up there and use it.
500,000 XP, the achievement **Hope of the Merudri** and the title *Pensive Wanderer*; Monks: the spell {spell:Focus Harmony} + 2% damage reduction against melee auto-attacks
Go back down the mountain the same way and head **north** again, across the steppes, to Issavi.

In the Issavi temple (or any city's temple), use the {item:Adventurer's Stone} to go to the Adventurers' Guild. On the floor above, next to the Reward Shrine, use the {wiki:Enchanted Guarded Crystal Sphere} to return to Blue Valley.

Talk to {npc:Enpa-Deia Pema} and say {key:hi} and {key:pilgrimage} to tell her you have visited all the shrines. As the final reward you get **10 Promotion Points** to spend on the {wiki:Wheel of Destiny}.

Use one of the {wiki:Guarded Crystal Sphere|Guarded Crystal Spheres} near the temple to return to the Adventurers' Guild and, from there, the guild's exit portal to go back to the temple you came from.

The wiki infobox says the 10 Promotion Points and the achievement are for **all vocations** and mentions 847.8 thousand XP in total; the spoiler table puts the XP in the *other vocations* column, so it is unclear whether Monks also get the XP.
Adding up the shrines, Monks get +25% base auto-attack (50% in Serene) and 20% damage reduction against melee auto-attacks (2% per shrine).

{npc:Enpa-Deia Pema} sells the Enlightenment items: Boots 8,000 gp, Fists 20,000 gp, Legs 40,000 gp, Nunchaku 50,000 gp, Coned Hat 70,000 gp, Sai 100,000 gp and Robe 150,000 gp. She also buys them (from 80 to 700 gp).
For the {wiki:Between the Lines Quest}, Monks need the {item:Coned Hat of Enlightenment}, which they get at the Shrine of Harmony.
